messages.subject: Re: range axis
parts:
On Wed, 2013-01-30 at 11:52 -0800, Regis HANK wrote:
> I am using ggplot2 version 0.9.2.1, , and i met a recurrent problem
> when i
> want to plot for example a bubble plot.
>
> My problem is the following , here a sample of my dataframe :
>
> 1Janvier 2010 144
> 2 Février 2010 92
> 3 Mars 2010 172
> 4 Avril 2010 62
> 5 Mai 2010 78
> 6 Juin 2010 106
> 7 Juillet 2010 3
> 8 Août 2010 4
> 9 Septembre 2010 109
> 10 Octobre 2010 165
> 11 Novembre 2010 59
> 12 Décembre 2010 88
>
> When i use ggplot to create a balloonplot, my axis x is range by
> alphabetical order and not as the logical order i.e :January,
> February
> etc..)
>
> How can i resolve this problem?

I believe you can do this if you make the month column a factor (or
perhaps an ordered factor) and specify the months in order like this:

month.f <- factor(month, levels=c("Janvier", "Febrier", ... etc. ))
